metadata.description: My Claude Code mods: a panel that switches them on and off, and the mods it manages.

plugins.name: mods
plugins.description: The mods panel: a switch per mod for this session and for every session, a control center (model, effort, stop), a session switcher and a done alert. No tokens.

plugins.name: flow
plugins.description: A progress bar and numbered task checklist above the prompt, and a pane with the subagents at work and the files they touch. Few tokens.

plugins.name: look
plugins.description: Zen mode hides tool noise while Claude works; skins give each project its own color palette. No tokens.

plugins.name: keepwarm
plugins.description: Keeps the prompt cache warm while you are away, and says when it has gone cold. Uses tokens.

plugins.name: reflect
plugins.description: Turns your corrections into one-line rules you can save for the project or for every project. Few tokens.

plugins.name: browser
plugins.description: A web page as readable text in a pane, with its console output and a small color preview. No tokens.
